content.purpose: See whether two files differ and identify the changed lines.
content.mentalModel: cmp answers whether bytes differ and where the first difference occurs; diff produces a line-oriented description useful for text.

demonstration.explanation: This small example isolates the main idea behind comparing files.

remember: cmp answers whether bytes differ and where the first difference occurs; diff produces a line-oriented description useful for text.
Verify the resulting state before moving on.

tasks.instruction: Compare old.conf with new.conf and save a normal diff showing both port values to /home/student/answers/config.diff.
hints: The answer must show changed text lines, not only a byte position.
Use diff with the old file first and the new file second.
diff uses exit code 1 for ordinary differences, which is not a command failure.
